tournaments.title: Tournaments
tournaments.subtitle: Everything you need to create, configure, and manage your tournaments.

create.title: Create a Tournament
create.description: From the "My Tournaments" section, click the "Create Tournament" button to start a new competition.

step1.title: Basic Information
step1.text: Enter the tournament name, description, and dates. The name will be visible to all participants.

step2.title: Location
step2.text: Optionally add a venue or location. This helps participants find where matches will be played.

step3.title: Format and Categories
step3.text: Select the tournament format and define the categories. You can configure this later from the settings.

manage.title: Manage Your Tournament
manage.description: Once created, access your tournament to manage all aspects from a single dashboard.

tabs.matches: View and manage all scheduled matches. You can create matches manually or generate them automatically from rounds.
tabs.standings: Track the tournament leaderboard in real time. Rankings update automatically as match results are recorded.
tabs.teams: See all registered teams and their details. Manage acceptances and team information.
tabs.info: View general tournament information, dates, and configuration.

rounds.title: Rounds
rounds.description: Rounds allow you to organize matches into groups. Create rounds to schedule batches of matches.
rounds.tip: You can create as many rounds as you need. Each round contains matches that are played within a defined time period.

settings.title: Settings
settings.description: From the settings page you can modify key tournament parameters: name, dates, format, and visibility.

teams.title: Teams
teams.subtitle: Learn how to register teams and manage your roster.

register.title: Register a Team
register.description: Anyone with the tournament registration link can register a team. You don't need an account to start, but you'll need one to manage the team later.

step1.title: Access the Link
step1.text: Get the registration link from the tournament administrator or find it on the public tournament page.

step2.title: Complete the Form
step2.text: Enter the team name and the required information. Some tournaments may require additional details.

step3.title: Confirmation
step3.text: Once registered, you'll receive confirmation. The team will appear in the tournament's team list.

manage.title: Manage Your Team
manage.description: After registering, you can access your team to add players and update information.
manage.players: Add players to your team roster. Each player needs a name and basic information.
manage.edit: Update team details such as name or additional information at any time.

players.title: Add Players
players.description: A team is made up of players. Add all members of your team so they can participate in matches.
players.tip: Players can be added at any time before or during the tournament, as long as the tournament rules allow it.

matches.title: Matches
matches.subtitle: How match scoring works and how to view results.

score.title: Score a Match
score.description: Referees can access the match scoring panel to record events in real time.

step1.title: Access the Panel
step1.text: From the referee section, select the match you want to score. You'll see the scoreboard with both teams.

step2.title: Record Events
step2.text: Use the scoring controls to add goals, cards, substitutions, and other incidents as they happen.

step3.title: End the Match
step3.text: When the match is over, finalize the score. The results will automatically update the tournament standings.

view.title: View Results
view.description: Match results are available from the tournament page. You can see the score, incidents, and detailed statistics.
view.public: Public tournament pages show match results without requiring login.

incidents.title: Incidents
incidents.description: During a match, various incidents can be recorded: goals, yellow cards, red cards, substitutions, and other relevant events.
incidents.tip: All incidents are saved in real time and are visible to tournament administrators.

players.title: Players
players.subtitle: Your personal dashboard, profile, and statistics.

dashboard.title: Player Dashboard
dashboard.description: The player dashboard is your personal control panel. From here you can access all your information.
dashboard.stats: View your statistics: matches played, goals scored, cards received, and more.
dashboard.teams: See all the teams you belong to and switch between them.
dashboard.matches: Review your match history with scores and incidents.

profile.title: Your Profile
profile.description: Keep your profile up to date with your personal information. This data is used by tournament administrators to identify you.
profile.tip: Upload a profile photo so teams and referees can easily identify you during matches.

stats.title: Statistics
stats.description: Track your performance across tournaments. Your stats are updated automatically as matches are scored.
stats.metrics: View matches played, goals, assists, cards, and other metrics depending on the sport.

matches.title: Match History
matches.description: Access a complete record of all your matches. Filter by tournament, date, or team to find specific games.
matches.detail: Click on any match to see detailed information: final score, incidents, lineups, and more.
